stem: Use a calculator to find the acute angle $\theta$, to the nearest degree, if ${=nm} \theta = {=r}$.
solution: Use the inverse function on the calculator: $\theta = {=nm}^{-1}({=r})$.
Reading the display and rounding to the nearest degree gives $\theta = {=angs[i]}^\circ$.
notes: No book questions were supplied, so parent_question_id is a placeholder. Ratios are 4 d.p. values of exact whole-degree angles, so the calculator answer is unambiguous.
